title: Account balance with running total CTE
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on transactions.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT txn_date, amount, balance FROM (SELECT txn_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance FROM transactions WHERE account_id = 1) ordered ORDER BY txn_date

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE transactions (id INT, account_id INT, amount INT, txn_date DATE); INSERT INTO transactions VALUES (1, 1, 1000, '2026-01-01'), (2, 1, -200, '2026-01-05'), (3, 1, 500, '2026-01-10');
